# tag_map { #labdata.gitutil.tag_map }

```python
labdata.gitutil.tag_map(repo)
```

Map commits to the tags pointing at them.

Annotated tags are peeled to the commit they wrap. Tags decorate versions
but never define them.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**repo**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Union](`typing.Union`)\[[Location](`labdata.location.Location`), [Path](`pathlib.Path`), [str](`str`)\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Working tree to inspect, on this machine or another.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Dict](`typing.Dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Tuple](`typing.Tuple`)\[[str](`str`), ...\]\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   A mapping of commit sha to a tuple of tag names.
